title: Peter Troob – Monkey Business in High Yield (Capital Allocators, EP.59)

reader_summary.headline: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators.
reader_summary.overview: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators. This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Through conversations with leaders in the money game, we learn how these holders of the keys to the kingdom allocate their time and their capital.

thesis: The speaker argues that large distressed funds with significant capital advantages now hold a competitive edge by being able to wait out smaller investors and execute structural deals like rights offerings. Consequently, the distressed investing landscape has shifted from a free-for-all to institutionalized fiefdoms where smaller players are increasingly ground up.
